# Specification items: sensor-host

| Item | Statement | Verification | Applies to | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-001 | When HAKO_SENSOR_DEVICE_SENSORS configures sensor instances, at least one enabled sensor chip must name a hakoniwa,sensor-instance with value-source; otherwise board construction stops with an error naming HAKO_SENSOR_DEVICE_SENSORS and value-source. | unit | sensor-host | hakoniwa,sensor-instance and sensor-chip value-source; docs/sensor-host.md, Wiring consistency |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-002 | When a board has an enabled hakoniwa,sensor-instance, no enabled sensor chip may name hakoniwa,sensor-device with value-source; otherwise board construction stops with an error naming the chip and both compatibles. | unit | sensor-host | hakoniwa,sensor-instance, hakoniwa,sensor-device and sensor-chip value-source; docs/sensor-host.md, Wiring consistency |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-003 | In FIFO operation an IMU chip reports each part's programmed sample period initially and after a rate change; before the next physics step the sensor host either makes the adapter follow or emits an ERROR naming the instance, part, chip period and adapter period. | unit | sensor-host | sensor-chip value-source to hakoniwa,sensor-instance; docs/sensor-host.md, Chip rates; AthrillDeviceSamplePeriodOps ABI 1.22 |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-004 | An enabled hakoniwa,sensor-instance without a configured plugin mapping stops board construction with an error that names the DEVICE_CONFIG_DEVICE_PLUGIN_1 hakoniwa%2Csensor-instance line to add. | unit | sensor-host | hakoniwa,sensor-instance compatible; docs/sensor-host.md, Wiring the chips to their instances |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-005 | Sample-period reports for pressure (kind 2), magnetometer (kind 3), and unknown future non-IMU kinds are informational; the sensor host does not reinterpret them as accelerometer periods, change an IMU adapter, or fail the run. | unit | sensor-host | sensor-chip value-source to hakoniwa,sensor-instance; docs/sensor-host.md, Wiring consistency; AthrillDeviceSamplePeriodOps ABI 1.22 |

## Test specifications

| Test spec | Stimulus | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-001.T1 | Build a board with HAKO_SENSOR_DEVICE_SENSORS set and every sensor chip wired to hakoniwa,sensor-device. | Construction fails before the firmware starts and the error names HAKO_SENSOR_DEVICE_SENSORS and value-source. |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-002.T1 | Build a board with a hakoniwa,sensor-instance and a sensor chip whose value-source is hakoniwa,sensor-device. | Construction fails and the error names the chip path, hakoniwa,sensor-device and hakoniwa,sensor-instance. |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-003.T1 | Start each supported IMU FIFO and change its programmed output data rate. | The value source receives the initial period for every FIFO part and receives the changed period. |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-003.T2 | Compare a 4 ms adapter with a 0.5 ms chip at a 0.125 ms physics step, using an adapter that supports only a shared IMU period. | The shared adapter is changed to 0.5 ms and the INFO names the instance, part and both periods; if both setters refuse, an ERROR names the same values and the adapter reason. |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-004.T1 | Build a board containing hakoniwa,sensor-instance with only the hakoniwa,sensor-device plugin mapping. | Construction fails and the diagnostic names DEVICE_CONFIG_DEVICE_PLUGIN_1 hakoniwa%2Csensor-instance and says to use the same library as plugin 0. |
| ADV-SENSOR-HOST-005.T1 | Report pressure, magnetometer, and an unknown future sample kind to the sensor-host period checker. | Each report is identified as informational and ignored without an error or modification of IMU period state. |
